    StartersEtta's ham and cheddar picnic baguettesHam, sharp cheddar, green apple and cornichons with mustard butter, pressedHow to make it2 baguettes60g salted butter2 tbsp wholegrain mustard250g leg ham, sliced150g sharp cheddar, sliced1 green apple, thinly sliced8 cornichons, halvedSplit the baguettes lengthways and cut each in half.Spread with butter and mustard.Layer with the ham, cheddar, apple and cornichons.Press closed, wrap tightly in baking paper and tie with string.Bolivian beef salteñasThe gang's new life in BoliviaHow to make itAs written, serves 4Sweet golden pastry turnovers crimped along the top, filled with a juicy spiced beef, potato, pea and olive stew, with a spoon of hot salsa.Cook 400g beef mince with 1 onion, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika and a chopped chilli, then add 1 diced boiled potato, 80g peas, 6 chopped olives and 150ml stock thickened with 1 tsp gelatine, and chill until set.Make dough from 400g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 100g melted butter, 1 egg and 150ml warm water.Roll 10 rounds, fill, fold and crimp along the top.Brush with egg and bake at 220°C for 18 minutes.Smoked trout with horseradish creamThe jump into the river. buttermilk1 eggBrown the beef in the oil in batches.Add the chillies, cumin, garlic and tomatoes and braise until tender.Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, buttermilk and egg into cornbread batter.Bake the cornbread at 200°C alongside.Serve the chilli with cornbread.Bolivian chicken and quinoa stewThe long trip south to BoliviaHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thighs simmered with onion, red chilli, tomato, cumin and quinoa until thick, finished with fresh herbs, lime and a hot llajwa salsa.Brown 1kg chicken thighs in oil, then add 1 diced onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli and 1 tsp cumin.Add 2 diced tomatoes, 150g rinsed quinoa and 1 litre chicken stock, cover and simmer 25 minutes until thick.Blend 3 tomatoes, 2 red chillies, coriander and salt for llajwa.Finish the stew with parsley and lime and serve with the salsa.SweetsBicycle ride lemon cakeLemon loaf soaked in hot lemon syrup under a lemon glazeHow to make it175g butter, softened175g
